In the temperature range [-40℃,160℃], the real part of the dielectric constant, the tangent value of the loss angle and the AC conductivity have a complex change process. Further, through theoretical analysis of the internal causes of the temperature gradient of UHV capacitive bushing, theoretical and practical analysis of the artificial intelligence algorithm for processing infrared and ultraviolet image database is given. The artificial intelligence image processing algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively output two-dimensional numerical images of the RBF network. Infrared image database processing algorithm and image noise elimination algorithm of substation power equipment are proposed. The original two-dimensional data of the field image is input into Bayesian topological network for the feature elimination after NHMC parameter learning. Take the UHV post insulator as an example. The seed point is automatically selected near the red point, and then the black and white binary growth of the image is started in the post insulator area, followed by morphological processing, and finally the edge mark is made for the UHV post insulator. This paper innovatively proposes the high voltage power bushing operation state evaluation method combining the artificial intelligence image processing algorithm and the broadband dielectric spectrum analysis technology, and proposes artificial intelligence algorithm image processing technology for safe and stable operation of high voltage power equipment.

articleTitle: Contrastive Node Representation Learning in Graph via Mutual Channel Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Contrastive learning is a recent hot topic in computer vision (CV), natural language processing (NLP), and even a broad perspective of artificial intelligence, which also has obtained increasing attention for self-supervised graph representation learning. However, most graph contrastive learning methods might sub-optimally integrate node features and topological structures in a complex graph with rich information. To address this issue and improve the richness of node representation learned from graphs, we propose a novel contrastive node representation learning in graph via Mutual Channel Distillation(MCD), which utilizes knowledge distillation and multichannel contrastive learning techniques to improve the quality of node embeddings. Our approach applies mutual channel distillation and multi-channel contrastive learning to help the student model and the teacher model learn from each other, allowing for more diversified and informative node representation to be generated. Experimental results demonstrated that MCD yielded competitive performance over baseline models on multiple node classification and clustering benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: A Kidney Tumor Segmentation Method Based on the Combination of U-Net and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: According to the characteristics of kidney tumours in abdominal multi-organ CT images, analyzing the CNN network to deal with long-distance connection defects and the shortage of Transformer structure detail processing, we designed a multimodal residual continuous convolution CNN and an improved multiscale dual-path multi-head attention Transformer combined with an encoder, deconvolution up-sampling, and learnable attention gating mechanism of the decoder with a jump junction introduced into the multiscale convolutional fusion module to form an asymmetric U-Net model framework for kidney tumour segmentation. Experimental comparison results show that the proposed method achieves an average dice coefficient of 0.9352, an average cross-merge rate of 0.9894, and a class-average pixel accuracy of 0.98235 for kidney segmentation metrics, which are more accurate and detailed than the existing and newer network models for segmentation.

articleTitle: Person Re-Identification Based on Instance Segmentation and Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Person Re-Identification (ReID) is a crucial task in computer vision that aims to match persons captured from non-overlapping camera views. In this paper, to alleviate the impacts of background and occlusion, we propose to use instance segmentation and pose estimation methods to create masks for global feature extraction. Furthermore, we divide the pedestrian images into three regions according to pedestrian keypoints, trying to eliminate the alignment errors. This part-based matching strategy also helps to address the occlusion issue. Overall, we construct a deep learning network with three branches, including two global branches and a part-based branch. The two global branches extract global features using segmentation-based mask and the mask derived from pedestrian keypoint heatmaps, respectively. In the end, a weighted fusion strategy is used to combine the global scores and part-based scores for final classification. This network enables us to acquire robust global feature of pedestrians by excluding background and occlusion, and simultaneously address the alignment errors to some extent. Experimental results on these three widely used datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method: Specifically, it achieves 64.5% rank-1 accuracy and 54.3% mAP on Occluded-Duke, and 94.4% and 87.1% rank-1 accuracies on Market-1501 and DukeMTMC-reID, respectively.

articleTitle: Nonnegative Preserving Projection for Dimensionality Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) is a method that represent classical data based on matrix decomposition. NMF is more compatible with real-world applications and improves readability because the decomposed elements must be non-negative. The original data, which is very redundant and noisy, is directly decomposed using NMF. It is generally high-dimensional. This will waste a lot of time and the obtained result of decomposition is also not optimal. To obtain a low-dimensional compact representation of observational data, in which the hidden semantic information is uncovered and the partial structure information is simultaneously preserved, a novel dimensionality reduction framework named nonnegative preserving projection (NPP) is proposed. In NPP, we firstly construct an affinity graph for encoding the geometrical information needed to capture the data's local manifold. Then, the projection matrix is introduced into NMF. Meanwhile, we apply a PCA-based constraint to the objective function to ensure that the bulk of the energy from the original data is preserved. We examined the proposed NPP with existing approaches in different picture databases to verify the performance of NPP in dimensionality reduction. According to the findings of the experiments, the procedure is both feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on GRU Based Emergency Material Delivery Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the influence of the large-scale flow mode of all kinds of emergency materials on the epidemic situation, this paper first analyzes the changes of the epidemic situation before and after putting in the vegetable package, and uses the time series clustering method to cluster the daily epidemic situation. It is determined that the vegetable package can control the epidemic situation to a certain extent. Then, the GRU prediction algorithm is established, and the epidemic data of unput vegetable bags in other regions at home and abroad are used to train GRU to predict the epidemic situation of unput vegetable bags in Changchun, and compared with the actual data, the accuracy of the algorithm reaches 97.8%. The results showed that the predicted data were significantly higher than the real data, both confirmed cases and asymptomatic infections. on the 32nd-40th day, the predicted confirmed cases were 2.7 times higher than the actual data. On the 23rd-81st day, the predicted asymptomatic data was 1.2 times higher than the actual data, which further verified that the vegetable package could effectively inhibit the epidemic.

articleTitle: Research on Regional Water Resources Classification Algorithm Based on Improved Deep Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In order to realize the rapid and accurate classification of regional water resources, this paper designs the regional water resources classification algorithm based on the improved deep residual network. This paper analyzes the overall situation of regional water resources distribution in China, and takes the remote sensing image of Gaf-2 satellite as the basis of algorithm design, and preprocesses the remote sensing image of regional water resources, such as enhancement, marking and segmentation. On this basis, the pyramid network is used to improve the depth residual network, and the improved depth residual network is combined with the pre-processing results of remote sensing image to obtain the regional water resources classification results. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has short preprocessing time, low classification error rate, short classification time and better practical application effect.

articleTitle: A Method for Maximizing Social Network Influence Considering Node Reading Effect and Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The dissemination of articles in social networks is not only related to the centrality of nodes, but also to the reading effect and delay of nodes. In order to more accurately measure the influence of nodes in the process of article dissemination, we propose a social network impact maximization method that considers the reading effect and delay of nodes. The reading effect of a node refers to the probability of forwarding and reading articles after receiving them, while the delay of a node refers to the time delay of forwarding or reading articles after receiving information. This method calculates the influence of each node during the article dissemination process by establishing an influence model that includes reading effect and delay, and selects some nodes as seed nodes. This method can improve the dissemination effect of articles and help design more effective social network marketing strategies and advertising placement plans.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Image Denoising with Subsampling and Residual Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Image denoising based on deep learning has made more extensive development by using a large amount of data for network training, however, it is difficult to obtain clean images without noise in actual scenarios, leading to the emergence of self-supervised deep learning technique. In this step, we raise two questions: how to improve the performance of self-supervised learning and how adaptive is the self-supervised method to various networks. In response to these issues, we propose a self-supervised image denoising scheme which generates image training pairs by subsampling the noisy image twice, and combines U-Net and ResNet to form an effective denoising network. As a result, we improve the denoising performance of the latest self-supervised method Neighbor2Neighbor by building a deeper convolutional network while avoiding gradient explosion through careful setting of training parameters. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the PSNR value by 0.3 dB and SSIM value by 0.004 on average compared to the original algorithm, and also verifies the robustness of the training strategy of Neighbor2Neighbor algorithm to different network structures.

articleTitle: Aerial Object Detection by UAV Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Aerial object detection is more difficult compared to general object detection. Indeed, aerial object detection remains a challenging task in computer vision object detection because it is highly susceptible to complex backgrounds. In addition, aerial targets often contain many small objects, and the limited pixel area of these small objects makes it challenging for current mainstream algorithms to detect them effectively. To solve the issues mentioned above, we propose a target detection algorithm called PM-YOLOv7 based on YOLOv7 for aerial images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). In terms of feature extraction, the original P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> feature extraction layer is removed. Based on this, a novel parallel backbone network is proposed. It integrates high-level and low-level features from two nearly identical backbone networks to handle complex images in aerial photography captured by UAVs. In terms of enhancing feature extraction, MLVC is used to capture global contextual information and long-term dependencies of input images. Experimental results on the challenging VisDrone2021 test-dev show that our proposed PM-YOLOv7 can achieve accuracy performance gains compared to YOLOv7.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Using Multi-Modal Feature Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Speech Emotion recognition (SER) aims to help machines recognize human emotions from utterances. Emotions are usually presented as audio and text in utterances. However, existing SER studies mostly use a single modality or a single feature, ignoring the integration of multiple modalities features. In this paper, we propose a multi-modal feature fusion network using cross-modal attention to extract emotion-related features from audio and text. More specifically, we use both audio and text, where the audio modality utilizes both wav2vec 2.0 features and Mel spectrograms. First, we combine text and wav2vec 2.0 features using the cross-modal fusion attention (CMFA) module. Then, the multi-modal fusion features are produced by concatenating the CMFA module’s multi-modal output with Mel spectrograms across MobileNet. Finally, comprehensive testing on the IEMOCAP dataset has shown that our proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: A Pre-game Item Recommendation Method Based on Self-Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: With the development of e-sports, Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) has become the most popular game type in the world. In addition to bringing huge commercial value, it also produces a large amount of rich public game data, which attracts researchers to deeply combine deep learning technology with MOBA. Among them, item recommendation is the core task, including pre-game item recommendation and in-game item recommendation. Compared with in-game item recommendation, pre-game recommendation faces serious data sparsity and missing data labels, which makes pre-game item recommendation a hard challenge. Existing methods pay more attention to conventional indicators such as precision and recall, but ignore the usability of results in MOBA, and have not fully considered the relationship between items. In this paper, we propose a pre-game item recommendation method based on self-supervised learning. While repairing the missing labels, the Transformer encoder is used to learn the relationship between items. Experimental results on a public dataset show that our method outperforms previous methods in terms of precision and usability indicators.

articleTitle: Feature Enhancement Algorithm for Recognition of Small Targets in Low Resolution Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Small object detection is a challenging task in computer vision due to limited pixels, low resolution, and sparse feature information. Existing infrared-based methods for small object detection suffer from low accuracy and susceptibility to environmental disturbances. This paper proposes a novel approach using an enhanced lightweight YOLOv5 network for high-precision infrared small object detection. The method involves capturing depth data using a ToF sensor, converting it to a four-channel RGB image through pseudo-color encoding, and applying HSV conversion. By preprocessing the depth values and incorporating them into the lightweight YOLOv5 model, the proposed approach extracts infrared small object detection features and improves the network's efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a significant improvement in detection performance, with an average precision of 97.4% on an enhanced dataset compared to pseudocolor encoded images.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of File Security Using Raspberry pi with an Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The aim of this study is to develop a secure file transfer solution for local area networks (LANs) using a Raspberry Pi 4 and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm. The system is designed to address the common security issue faced by institutions where clients must transfer files over a network while maintaining confidentiality. The researchers implemented a duplicate server system using the Raspberry Pi 4 and a WIFI router to store and manage files uploaded by clients. The AES algorithm was utilized to encrypt all files uploaded to the system to ensure data security. The solution is also user-friendly and includes a web page interface for administrators to manage user access. The researchers conducted a series of experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed solution. Results indicate that the same server system and AES encryption effectively secure files in a LAN environment. Files uploaded through the system can only be accessed by the correct user account, ensuring confidentiality and data integrity. Even if the admin can view the user account, they cannot open the file since it is encrypted. The researchers also measured the system's file transfer speed performance and found it comparable to traditional LAN file transfer methods. The study demonstrates how encryption can be used to address security risks faced by institutions and other organizations. The researchers recommend that further studies be conducted to evaluate the system's scalability and performance in large-scale LAN environments.

articleTitle: Vehicles Detection and Counting Method from Overhead View based on Embedded Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In modern society, vehicles are indispensable carriers in transportation and daily life. The rapid increase in the number of vehicles has contributed to the development of intelligent traffic monitoring. Vehicle counting allows for a quick understanding of the traffic flow on the road and the parking situation in the parking lot. This enables the management of traffic. In recent years, vehicle counting techniques which is based on image processing have been innovated. However, there are still challenges to effectively utilize image processing methods for vehicle counting. In this paper, an efficient vehicle counting algorithm using ORB algorithm and Sliding Window Method is proposed. To be able to improve the efficiency of vehicle detection, the Frame Difference Method is used to detect whether there are moving objects. Based on the results of vehicle counting on the parking lot video. The method is able to efficiently and accurately identify the number of vehicles in a parking lot. And it can be deployed to small embedded devices.

articleTitle: Emergency Communication Network Coverage Method based on UAV Self-organizing Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In recent years, more and more attention has been paid to emergency management, and emergency communication, as an important part of the national emergency management system, has also received much attention. The ground emergency communication vehicle is the representative of emergency communication, but it is only suitable for the situation of flat ground. Compared with emergency communication vehicles, UAV has the advantage of flexible networking, which is the reason why UAV is concerned. But the UAV battery capacity, short working time. The energy consumption of UAV is mainly flight consumption and communication consumption. In this paper, a media access control protocol for UAV ad hoc network is designed, to reduce the cost of the protocol to reduce energy consumption, and then extend the UAV working time to the lowest energy consumption, to meet the coverage requirements.

articleTitle: An Improved SIOU-YoloV5 Algorithm Applied to Human Flow Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: At present, object detection technology in computer vision is widely used to monitor an area and obtain the information of the scene. This study is aimed at stampede accidents, using this technology to detect the size of the human flow. In this paper, based on the basic framework of YOLO, in order to obtain more detection accuracy and stability in the identification of human traffic, a variety of LOSS functions are improved to improve the detection performance of the same scene. Then, the results obtained after these improvements were evaluated, and compared with the original YOLOV5, it can be concluded that the performance of various improved methods in the human flow detection is better, the target detection is more accurate, and the recognition accuracy is improved. The results show that the improvement effect of SIOU is the best, with a 1% increase in each indicator. Therefore, SIOU is more suitable for human flow detection.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Techniques for UAV Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Aiming at the requirements of target tracking applications of UAV aerial images, the traditional target tracking methods have problems such as too strong dependence on the target motion model, significantly reduced accuracy in occlusion or interference, difficulty in judging tracking failure, and poor real-time performance, which are difficult to meet the practical application requirements. In this paper, a fast target tracking model based on Siamese neural network is designed to make the algorithm have high real-time performance. Combined with actual application requirements, two usage modes are designed, one is automatic target recognition then entering tracking, and the other is manually selecting targets then entering tracking. Based on the actual UAV aerial image data and the public infrared dataset, the average tracking success rate can reach more than 90%, and the test performance on the NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX board can reach 22 frames per second, which can meet the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Using Image Enhancement for Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In UAV aerial photography scenes, lighting changes, image blur, low resolution and other factors have a great impact on tracking performance, and previous target tracking algorithms mainly studied robust tracking under sufficient light and high resolution. This article proposes an adaptive image enhancement algorithm for unmanned aerial vehicle target tracking, which achieves robust tracking of unmanned aerial vehicles under dark changes in lighting and insufficient lighting. Firstly, an adaptive image enhancement module is constructed to identify the dark light scene and compensate for the corresponding image brightness and image contrast. Secondly, a dynamic constraint strategy is added to constrain the difference in tracking response, enabling the tracker to achieve time adaptation. Finally, experiments on two UAV benchmarks have proven the superiority of our method compared to other nine state-of-the-art trackers.

articleTitle: Random Error Modeling Method for Gyrowheel Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Gyrowheel is a promising device for small spacecrafts, as it integrates both the attitude actuating and the angular velocity sensing capabilities. Random error is the major determinant of the measurement accuracy of the gyrowheel. However, large tilt angles and de-tuned spin speeds of the gyrowheel rotor result in special characteristics of its random error, which brings challenges of extracting and modeling the random error. To overcome the challenges, a random error extraction method is proposed by adopting the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) technique. And on this basis, a deep neural network-based random error modeling method for the gyrowheel is developed by utilizing a stack-block architecture. Validation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Estimation Using a Variational Autoencoder-Regression Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Accurate Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation is beneficial for maintenance decisions. Data-driven approaches such as deep learning (DL) have achieved outstanding performance for RUL prediction. However, DL cannot interpret the data. In this paper, we propose a novel DL framework to predict RUL and simultaneously generate a fault diagnostic map that reflects the characteristics of the data. The model is primarily composed of a variational autoencoder and a regression layer referred to as VAR. The variational autoencoder (VAE) consists of a bidirectional long short-term memory network (Bi-LSTM) with an attention mechanism. The VAR model is validated by simulations on the C-MAPSS dataset and compared with other state-of-the-art methods, and the results demonstrate the superiority of the VAR model.

articleTitle: Improved K-means Template Matching Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Target recognition mainly includes feature extraction and target classification based on features. This paper mainly improves the traditional target classification algorithm based on K-means template matching to improve the target recognition rate. In view of the problems that the matching template established by the traditional target classification algorithm based on K-means template matching cannot accurately represent the distribution of recognition targets, the clustering center is fuzzy, and the recognition rate of some targets is low, this paper proposes an improved target classification algorithm based on K-means template matching. In the process of template establishment, more subclasses are added, and the mapping between subclasses and recognition targets is established. Thus, the problem of fuzzy clustering center is solved, and the target recognition rate is improved. Compared with the target classification algorithm based on SVM, it can achieve better target recognition rate with lower computation.

articleTitle: UAV Vehicle Detection Method and Application Based on Improved TOOD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In the intelligent management of city traffic, the object detection of UAV vehicles plays a crucial role. Fixed-view cameras cannot comprehensively monitor urban road traffic, and using the flexibility and wide-area view of UAV can supplement the monitoring range of fixed cameras, improve intelligent traffic management and enhance urban traffic management efficiency. However, the limited resources of the UAV load platform and the unique viewpoint and flexibility of UAV imaging lead to image degradation and uneven sample distribution. To address these problems, a UAV vehicle obejct detection method based on TOOD was proposes in this study, where we use a lightweight network, RegNet-800M, as the feature extraction backbone network to reduce computational overhead and improve feature extraction. At the same time, we incorporate an attention mechanism module based on RegNet-800M to optimize the information processing capability of the model through both spatial and channel dimensions. The results show that the proposed method achieves an average accuracy of 55% and a detection speed of 31.6 FPS on the VisDone-2019 subset, and by balancing accuracy and speed, the method meets real-time standards and practical industry requirements.

articleTitle: Combining CNN and Transformer for Noise-Robust Image Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS), as a signal acquisition and reconstruction method, benefits from deep learning technology and can quickly and accurately reconstruct signals from a small number of observations. Emerging Transformer networks bring significant gains to CS while also leaving unresolved issues. One obvious issue is that the reconstruction performance of CS methods drops sharply in the presence of noise. To achieve accurate CS reconstruction in noisy scenes, this paper proposes to improve the latest Transformer-based CS method with a CNN correction module, resulting in a joint scheme for noise-robust image CS recovery. The scheme adopts a combination of a deep learning reconstruction module and a denoising module. Specifically, it consists of a reconstruction module with a sampling subnet for a trainable perceptual matrix strategy, an initial reconstruction subnet, a hybrid reconstruction subnet, and a trainable denoising module. Extensive experiments show that the scheme can effectively improve the image quality and noise robustness of compressed sensing reconstruction.

articleTitle: Entity Relationship Extraction for Chinese Electronic Medical Records Based on Tightly Cascaded Binary Pointers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Relationship extraction, as a subtask of information extraction, converts unstructured medical data in electronic medical records into structured data, which lays the foundation for subsequent knowledge graph construction. The existing relationship extraction ignores the potential relationships of similar entities in a single sentence and fails to make full use of the relationships among the closer entities in the text. Thus, we propose a novel tightness mechanism that increases the correlation between head and tail entities to better determine the relationship between similar entities. The experiments of the proposed model on the public dataset demonstrate that the model can extract the triples more accurately and the F1 value is improved by 2.84% over the baseline model.

articleTitle: 3Detection of Urban Underground Sewage Pipeline Based on YOLOv5-Ghostnet Lightweight Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: To detect anomalies in the sewer environment, we identified five common faults: pipe breakage, deformation displacement, accumulation, corrosion, and detachment. However, traditional target detection methods are often cumbersome, slow, and not efficient. To address these challenges, we proposed a new YOLOv5 lightweight detection technology that introduced feature extraction mechanisms from GhostNet, ShuffleNet, and MobileNet. These mechanisms significantly reduce the computation cost of the model and are suitable for comparative experiments. After introducing the GhostNet feature extraction mechanism, it can be observed that the amount of computation and the substantial decrease in the number of model parameters. The mean average precision also increased from 87.4% to 88.5%. This improvement maintains the detection accuracy while reducing the model's weight. Our research provides an essential reference for lightweight research in this field.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv7 for Small and Overlapping Objects Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Object detection is a crucial task in Deep Learning applications. However, detecting small, overlapping objects in complex scenes has always been challenging. To overcome this challenge, we propose a new algorithm based on YOLOv7, which incorporates a multi-path attention enhancement module in the neck part and a receptive field enhancement module on the feature layer responsible for forecasting small objects before the head. This allows all detection layers to focus more effectively on features that require attention and enhance receptive fields. Our experiments on the PASCAL VOC dataset demonstrate that our proposed approach significantly improves the detection of small and overlapping objects compared to YOLOv7.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Lung Lesions in Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: This paper designs a target detection algorithm based on Transformer network architecture. Swin Transformer was used to extract features of lesion areas in lung medical images based on zero basic training, and the extracted feature images were embedded into the detection segmentation network Mask R-CNN to accurately locate and classify all suspected lesion areas in lung medical images. Multi-scale feature extraction and feature fusion are carried out through network, which solves the problems of focus region recognition caused by single resolution, weak communication between different layers and lack of attention fusion. After submitting the test on the open data set, the mAP accuracy can reach 0.118, which is better than the mainstream target detection algorithm and provides a reference scheme for the application of computer-aided diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Part-based Person Re-Identification with Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Person re-identification(Re-ID) is a crucial task in computer vision, which aims to match pedestrian images captured in non-overlapping camera views. It has significant implications for public safety applications. However, current methods primarily rely on global features and thus are vulnerable to background clutters and occlusion. To address these issues, this paper proposes a part-based Re-ID method using the Swin Transformer. In this method, we first utilize human pose estimation method to detect the body keypoints of a pedestrian. We then extract local windows and patches centered at these keypoints, so as to minimize the involvement of background and occlusion information in the down-stream re-identification. These body parts in pose guided windows are fed to the Swin Transformer network. The hierarchical structure of Swin Transformer also enables the proposed method more robust to multi-scale problems. Our experimental results on both holistic and occluded datasets, i.e., Market-1501, DukeMTMC-reID, and Occluded-Duke, demonstrate that the proposed method is on par with the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Detection of Children Abuse by Voice and Audio Classification by Short-Time Fourier Transform Machine Learning Implemented on Nvidia Edge GPU Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Children's safety in the home has become an increasing social concern, and the purpose of this experiment is to use machine learning to detect child abuse scenarios in order to improve children's safety. This experiment uses machine learning to classify and recognize children's voices and to predict whether the current sound the child is making is crying, screaming or laughing. If a crying or screaming sound is detected from a child, an immediate alert is sent to the relevant personnel so that they can sense what the child may be experiencing and respond in a timely manner in the blind spot of the surveillance. Together with the hybrid use of video image classification, the accuracy of child abuse detection can be greatly improved. This greatly reduces the likelihood of children being violently abused in childcare centers and allows staff to stop impending or recent child abuse incidents in a timely manner. The dataset collected for this experiment was derived exclusively from sounds recorded on-site at the children's home, including cries, laughter, screams, and background noise. In this experiment, the short-time Fourier transform is used to transform the sound signals into spectrograms, and the image signals are imported into a convolutional neural network for training and prediction, and the final trained model has an accuracy of about 92% for sound detection.

articleTitle: Research on Bidirectional LSTM Recurrent Neural Network in Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Speech recognition is a very useful artificial intelligence technology, which has been widely used in various fields and has great potential for development. With the continuous progress of technology, speech recognition will become an indispensable part of people’s daily life, but in the process of further development of speech recognition, there are still many problems that have not been solved. For example, speech signals are susceptible to a variety of interference factors, such as noise, speaker accent, which may lead to the degradation of speech recognition performance. In speech recognition, it is often necessary to process long time sequences of speech signals, such as continuous conversations of speakers, long sentences in speech recognition tasks. Traditional recurrent neural networks may suffer from gradient disappearance or gradient explosion, which makes it difficult for the model to capture long-term dependencies. In this paper, our primary focus is designing a bidirectional LSTM recurrent network structure [10]. We utilize the CTC algorithm to calculate the loss and employ the cluster search decoding algorithm for decoding the network’s output. Compared with the bidirectional LSTM recurrent neural network with 5 hidden layers, the pinyin text recognition can reach 85% correct rate, 5% less training times, and 6% less wrong pinyin words in individual sentences at 15%. Some of the recognition rates presented in this paper may appear suboptimal due to noise in individual speech signals and other factors. How to denoise has been the focus of speech recognition in neural networks.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization LSTM Neural Network for Navigation Satellite Clock Bias Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: To tackle the issue of low forecast accuracy in navigation satellite clock bias forecast models, this paper proposes an LSTM neural network clock bias forecast model that utilizes the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. The model employs the PSO algorithm to seek optimal values for the structural parameters of the LSTM neural network, which reduces the likelihood of local extremes in the LSTM model. The model is then tested using precision clock bias data from the Wuhan International GNSS Service (IGS) center. The forecast results are compared and analyzed against those of the traditional gray GM (1, 1) model, the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model, the Quadratic Polynomial (QP) model, and the LSTM neural network model. The results demonstrate that the accuracy of the LSTM neural network model optimized by the particle swarm algorithm is superior to the other models mentioned in this paper for clock bias forecasting. The satellite clock bias forecasting method based on the particle swarm algorithm optimized LSTM neural network provides a new approach to enhance the accuracy of satellite clock bias forecasting.

articleTitle: An Improved SOFT-YOLOv5 Algorithm Applied to Computer Motherboard Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: As far as we know, computers are very mature electronic products. With time passing, most computers are assembled by the manufacturer before distribution. However, a problem occurs when people send their computers for repair. Maintainers often increase the time cost of maintenance due to some subtle components on the computer motherboard. In order to improve the efficiency of maintenance and quickly locate the place that needs to be repaired or replaced, in this paper, we improve the NMS operation in Yolov5 by using the SOFT-NMS algorithm, which successfully improves the performance of YOLOv5 in defect detection on computer motherboards. Compared to YOLOv5, the precision value of SOFT-YOLOv5 increases from 83.3% to 84.2% and the mAP@0.5 value of SOFT-YOLOv5 increases from 87.1% to 90.3%. Consequently, SOFT-YOLOv5 has better performance on computer motherboard defect detection.

articleTitle: Photo Album Creation for Historical Newspaper through Computer Vision by Using ABBYY, VGG Model, and Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In this paper we presented a novel approach with Computer Vision and Machine/Deep Learning for building digital image albums and storytelling with images from historical newspapers. In total 456 newspaper pages have been used to execute the proposed method. Different methodologies, including ABBYY FineReader, VGG nls-chapbook model, and Yolov5, were compared and evaluated. Image categorization has also been studied with Face Recognition and OCR methodologies. Experimental results showed that the proposed method successfully extracted and categorized the illustrations of 106 actors/actresses which were then used to create their personal photo albums. Our experiment with image detection for photo album building demonstrated the potential of our approach to fit other newspaper or digitized collections. The result photo album of historical personalities allowed users to have a more comprehensive understanding of the newspaper article mentioned about the actors/actresses and their multifaceted biographical information as well.

articleTitle: Dynamic Language Refinement for Graceful Degradation in Scene Text Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Scene text recognition is a mature technology which can get a near-perfect result in regular scenes. However, there are still troubles in recognizing scene texts with image blur, characters missing, and occlusion. Recent end-to-end frameworks have investigated the importance of linguistic knowledge, utilizing either implicit or explicit language models. However, joint training of language and vision models tends to interfere the tunings of each other. In this paper, we present a novel gradient isolation method to train language and vision models separately, yet in an end-to-end architecture. In addition, we propose a dynamic iterative training procedure for graceful refining the language model. Extensive experiments confirm that the proposed method has superiority on regular and irregular scene text images and achieves state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: End-to-End Tibetan-Chinese Speech Translation Based on Multi-task and Multi-level Pre-training
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: End-to-end speech translation is a technology capable of translating speech in the source language directly into text in the target language, and it can mitigate the propagation errors that cascade system can introduce. Nevertheless, compared to relatively mature speech recognition and machine translation, the present challenge of end-to-end speech translation is the lack of parallel corpus data for low-resource minority languages. This creates obstacles in building efficient speech translation models. In this paper, we propose a model for end-to-end Tibetan-Chinese speech translation based on the multi-task and multi-level pre-training strategy to address the issue of scarce Tibetan-Chinese parallel corpus data. Our model extends the Transformer speech translation model with a speech recognition decoder and constructs a multi-task learning model that shares the encoder. Moreover, we utilize high-resource ST training data and ASR training data and adopt a multi-level pre-training strategy during the training process to improve the generalization of the Tibetan-Chinese speech translation model. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method effectively enhances the ability of Tibetan-Chinese speech translation in low-resource environments, outperforming both the end-to-end baseline models and simple multi-task learning models.

articleTitle: Fish Identification Method Based on Oriented Fast and Rotated Brief Algorithm and Convolutional Neural Network in Muddy Sea
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: As an important part of marine pastures, artificial reefs play an important role in the protection of marine living resources. However, the artificial reef can not be released indefinitely, and the fish near the reef will choose whether to inhabit or not because of different environmental factors. Therefore, how to explore the impact of underwater fish and other marine life factors, screening the release site is particularly important.Therefore, it is necessary to study the underwater fish identification in different time. In this paper, an underwater fish recognition model based on embedded platform is proposed, which will be applied to the real environment soon. In this paper, the artificial reef area by video pre-processing, and then using digital image processing and machine learning methods for different periods of fish recognition. The two-frame difference method is used to determine the direction of fish movement and to realize fish tracking, and the fish counting in the detection environment is realized by combining ORB algorithm with image segmentation algorithm and KNN algorithm. To analyze whether different reef-building materials, artificial reefs of different configurations and different water quality environment affect the fish habitat, therefore, it can provide scientific support for the rational development and management of marine resources, the protection of marine ecosystem and the protection of marine ecological security.

articleTitle: Transformer Speech Synthesis for Tibetan Lhasa Dialect Based on Multilevel Granular Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The application of Tacotron model in Tibetan end-to-end speech synthesis has achieved good results, however, this model which is based Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) suffers from low training and prediction efficiency and long-range information loss. To further improve the effect of Tibetan speech synthesis, an end-to-end speech synthesis model based on Transformer is proposed to realize the speech synthesis of multiple dialects of Tibetan. In the model, the hidden state in the Encoder and Decoder is constructed in parallel by using the multi-head attention mechanism, which effectively solves the problem of modeling long-distance information correlation and can take the advantage of multi-GPU parallel training. In this work, three different granular units (Tibetan characters, Latin letters, and Tibetan components) are selected as the input to the acoustic model for the purpose of selecting the best granular unit to improve synthesis result. The Transformer TTS network transforms the text sequences into Mel spectrograms, and the WaveNet vocoder converts the Mel spectrograms into final speech waveforms. This study conducts a series of comparative experiments. Firstly, the performances of three synthesis granular units based on our proposed method are compared, and then the effects of single-GPU training and multi-GPU parallel training are compared. In addition, a comparative experiment of Tacotron and Transformer applied to Tibetan Lhasa dialect speech synthesis is conducted. The experimental results show that the end-to-end speech synthesis model based on Transformer has better performance than Tacotron in Tibetan Lhasa dialect speech synthesis. The speech obtained by using Latin letters as the synthesis unit and parallel training with multi-GPU has better clarity and naturalness.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection Method in UAV Images Based on Improved ObjectBox
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In recent years, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been widely applied in various fields. Most detection is limited to fixed-view scenarios, while UAV-based object detection has a broader view and can monitor wider areas. However, the size of vehicles in images may change significantly and become smaller due to the changing and increasing distance between the drone and the ground, thus making vehicle detection challenging. In order to address the issue, a vehicle detection method for UAV aerial images based on ObjectBox was proposed. We replaced the original neck network with FPN to adapt to multi-scale object detection. Moreover, the Shuffle Attention module was added to FPN, improving its capability to obtain channel interaction information and spatial information by channel and spatial attention mechanisms. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved ObjectBox detector. With a stronger neck network, we achieved a mean average accuracy of 55% and a real-time inference time of 39 FPS on the VisDrone sub-dataset. The proposed network keeps a balance between accuracy and speed to meet the requirements of practical applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Berthing Based on Reinforcement Learning and Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Berthing is one of the most critical and complex operations for ships. Application of automatic berthing control can improve the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of vessel maneuvering. Current studies on automatic berthing control systems are mostly based on optimal control theory or artificial neural networks. These control methods either have low environmental adaptability or need large amounts of data to support the training process. In this paper, a novel method for automatic ship berthing that combines reinforcement learning with feedback control is proposed. Such method can adapt to different ship and navigation environments by automatically adjusting control parameters. This simplifies the controller deployment on board and reduces the data requirement for agent training. Simulations show that the proposed methods could handle auto-berthing problem in various scenarios.

articleTitle: DFF: Distributed Forward-Forward Algorithm for Large-Scale Model in Low-Performance Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The advancement of Artificial Intelligence(AI) technology, especially with the success of Large Language models(LLMs) like ChatGPT and image generation models such as Stable Diffusion, signifies that AI has entered a new era of large-scale models. However, the rapid development of AI models has brought about the disaster of unlimited growth in model size such as the latest LLM model, PanGu-Sigma, which has reached an astonishing size of 1085B. For ordinary individuals, the enormous hardware costs for these large-scale models make it impossible to train and infer a large model. Fortunately, Geoffrey Everest Hinton has proposed the Forward-Forward(FF) algorithm, which aims to deconstruct a large model into smaller layers and each layer updates its weights through its own backpropagation process, which means that each layer is independent. Therefore, inspired by Geoffrey Hinton’s work, this paper introduces a new Distributed Forward-Forward(DFF) algorithm, which distributes each layer of the Forward-Forward algorithm model to different devices based on ROS2’s publisher-subscriber communication mechanism. Then, the model can be computed across different devices. The Distributed Forward-Forward(DFF) algorithm system in this paper theoretically allows multiple low-performance devices to jointly run large models that a single device is hard to run. Classification model tests on MNIST and CIFAR10 datasets show that the accuracy is 0.9292 and 0.4249 respectively, which has the comparable performance of the pure Forward-Forward algorithm (0.9315 and 0.4310). Our implementation is available at [Github].

articleTitle: Fiber-Optic Signal Based Deep Learning for Sleep Medicine Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: As living standards continue to improve, people are becoming increasingly concerned about their own health and the quality of their sleep. However, currently available sleep monitoring devices often have issues with uncomfortable wear and low data accuracy, which limit users’ experience and the effectiveness of data analysis. At the same time, there is increasing attention to real-time monitoring technology based on human physiological indicators in response to the demand for personalized healthcare management. In this context, fiber optic signal technology has emerged. By utilizing fiber optic sensing technology, it is possible to non-invasively acquire subtle human signals, such as respiratory rate and heart rate. This paper proposes an algorithm combining microprocessor and machine learning technology, which can effectively identify the user’s sleep state and Physical change, and improve the accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: Mixed Pixel Saturability Based Area Estimation Model on Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Remote sensing technology has been widely applied in multiple fields with surface monitors, and area estimation is one of key problems. Currently, researchers usually compute the area directly according to the number of pixels, which is often affected by factors such as image resolution, resulting in large errors in the area estimation. Therefore, in order to alleviate the drawback and improve the accuracy of area estimation, we propose a Mixed Pixel Saturability based Wide Region Area Estimation Model on Remote Sensing Image Data (MPS), which can be utilized to estimate areas in wide regions. The proposed model firstly declares a new definition named mixed pixels saturability which adequately considers the structure of remote sensing images in spatial, further, a weighting process method is introduced to eliminate the influence of outliers and improve the generalization capability of the area estimation model. Then, we conduct experiments on cropland remote sensing image datasets, the results show that the proposed area estimation model outperforms the existing models. It improves the accuracy of the wide region remote sensing image area estimation and provides the basis for remote sensing-based area monitoring.

articleTitle: Robust Zero-Watermarking Algorithm for Medical Images Based on Direction Gradient Histogram and DCT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, using the Internet to transmit medical images has gradually become an efficient and convenient transmission method. It improves the efficiency of medical services, enabling medical institutions and doctors to share medical images and diagnostic information quickly. However, there are also some potential security risks in transmitting medical images over the Internet, such as data leakage and tampering. This article proposes a medical image zero-watermarking algorithm based on the direction gradient histogram (HOG) and discrete cosine transform (DCT) to solve the above problems. The proposed algorithm first extracts the feature vector of the medical image and then utilizes the perceptual hash algorithm to obtain its corresponding feature sequence. The watermark image is then encrypted using chaotic scrambling through logical mapping. The zero-watermarking technique is employed for the embedding and extraction of the watermark. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in successfully extracting and restoring the watermark even under challenging conditions.

articleTitle: Localization of Focal Intractable Epileptic Focus Based on Long-Term Recurrent Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In clinic, the success rate of surgical resection of the epileptic focus in the treatment of focal intractable epilepsy is only about 25%. The main reason for the low success rate is that the location of epileptic focal is difficult to accurately determine. Although some methods have built models to automatically identify the location of epileptic focal according to the characteristic differences between focal electroencephalogram (EEG) and non-focal EEG, the recognition accuracy of previous methods needs to be further improved. We note that the previous methods only consider the spatial differences and do not take the variation differences in the time domain into account. In this study, we intend to combine the convolution neural network and the long short-term memory neural network to construct a time-space deep learning model (long-term recurrent convolutional network, LRCN) to improve the accuracy of EEG recognition of epileptic focal. Based on the LRCN model, we achieved an accuracy of 97.13% for epileptic focal recognition, which performed out the existing methods.

articleTitle: Deep Ranking for COVID-19 Community QA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: With the rapid acceleration of technological advancements in recent years, society has seen a growing interconnection through the internet. Questions, issues, and confusion spread at a rapid pace, oftentimes inundating professional news outlets and clinical research, which cannot keep up and consequently neglect issues that are new, unknown, or relatively niche. For societal micro-shift trends and social or creative questions, community-based question and answer platforms such as Quora, Reddit, and social media platforms like Instagram and Twitter are far more effective. However, they pose the critical flaw of disorganization and difficulty of user navigation; users must scour through countless repetitive questions and unrelated answers in order to find accurate and appropriate responses to their inquiries. In this paper, a community-based question and answer relevancy ranking system has been developed via advanced deep machine-learning architecture. With its ability to accurately retrieve the most relevant answers to a user-given question, our model greatly assists users with navigating community question and answer platforms with much more ease. Altogether, it significantly improves the accuracy and effectiveness of community-based question and answer platforms. Text data from the COVID-19 Open Research Dataset (CORD-19) [15] was cleaned and incorporated to train our model, which consists of a novel DeepCross Network with embedding features as input, designed with a special dual architecture utilizing both Cross Networks and Deep Networks. Through extensive offline experimentation, we tuned and refined various parameters to validate our model’s feasibility and demonstrate significant improvements in efficiency. Ultimately, our model achieved 97% AUC (Area Under the Curve), a significant upgrade compared to the 52% baseline.

articleTitle: Automatic Soldering Defect Detection for Tantalum Capacitors in Printed Circuit Boards
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The automatic detection system proposed in this paper mainly focuses on automatic welding errors detection for tantalum capacitors. Without manual labeling standard PCBs, it can automatically determine the positions and directions of the tantalum capacitors in PCBs and implement automatic labeling by means of segmentation, coarse-fine positioning, direction detection. In the test, the positions and directions of the tantalum capacitors in the PCBs under test can be automatically detected and matched with those in the corresponding standard PCBs, further finding the tantalum capacitors those are missing or in wrong directions in the PCBs under test. On one hand, this method does not need a lot of experienced workers to detect the soldering defects of tantalum capacitors, reducing the probability of defective PCBs being categorized as non-defective due to workers' fatigue or carelessness. It reduces economic cost a lot. On the other hand, unlike deep learning algorithms, it does not need a lot of training examples and performs well on a lot of PCBs whose sizes, shapes and densities of components are unknown before. This improves the productivity and ensures rapid PCB images collection and rapid detection of welding errors. The application shows that the average speed can reach 15 frames per second, and the accuracy is greater than 98%.

articleTitle: A Multielement Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, the classification and recognition of wasps has become one of the hot issues in research. The paper based on the text and images in the provided data set. Firstly, input the image data of the wasp into the deep residual network to obtain its confidence coefficient, with an accuracy of 75%; Then, the obtained text reports are generated into training sets, test sets, and validation sets, and the Skip gram method is used to supervise and train the text recognition model. Thirdly, using support vector machines for classification has an accuracy of 82.73%. Finally, the recognition results of the image and text are weighted to obtain the final classification result. Examples have shown that this method has good recognition performance.

articleTitle: West Syndrone Seizure Detection Algorithm based on Fusion Network of EEG and EMG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: West syndrome is an epileptic encephalopathy that will impact the cognitive development of children. To effectively diagnose West syndrome, effective utilization of electroencephalogram (EEG) and electromyography (EMG) signals is crucial. Previous studies have conducted limited investigations on the integration and comparison of EEG and EMG systems. Hence, this research aims to construct and evaluate the effectiveness of a fusion network composed of EEG and EMG by constructing and analyzing its performance. The algorithm is evaluated using EEG data from 12 patients with West syndrome collected by the Children’s Hospital Affiliated with Zhejiang University School of Medicine. With the 5-fold cross-validation method, the algorithm achieves an average accuracy, precision, sensitivity and F1 score of 93.45%, 92.42%, 94.44% and 93.30%, respectively, indicating a high level of detection performance.

articleTitle: Conformer Based End-to-End ASR System with a New Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In recent years, the proliferation and refinement of neural networks have engendered pioneering advancements in several domains that rely on machine learning and deep learning techniques. Neural network technology has also brought about significant advancements in the field of speech recognition. The current neural networks in various fields are dominated by transformer and conformer. This study explores the current mainstream frameworks and focuses on the research of the conformer network architecture, providing a brief description of its structure. In addition to investigating the mainstream frameworks, the authors discovered that some small plug-and-play attention mechanism frameworks introduced in previous years still yield impressive results, such as ResNet, SeNet, and others. Subsequently, the authors took a closer look at these small plug-and-play frameworks and finally selected resnet as the innovation point. Based on these two, a novel feature fusion framework, the res-Conv model, is proposed. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model, the authors applied the model to the current mainstream open-source speech recognition tool wenet, using the dataset Aishell-1 and LibriSpeech. After continuous debugging, the results show that the proposed res-Conv model, compared to the baseline, achieved a reduction in Character Error Rate (CER) of 0.71-0.82% on the Aishell dataset and a reduction in Word Error Rate (WER) of 0.47-0.53% on the LibriSpeech dataset, while almost maintaining the same number of parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-stream Temporally Enhanced Network for Video Salient Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Video salient object detection (VSOD) aims at locating the most attractive objects in a video by exploring the temporal and spatial features. Despite the progress made in existing VSOD models, there is still a tendency to prioritize temporal features over spatial features. This bias has been shown to result in the imprecise localization of salient objects in the spatial domain and the accumulation of interframe noise in the temporal domain. We aim to investigate saliency cues collaboration in the spatial domain, along with a straightforward, yet efficient approach for temporal feature extraction. This paper proposes a multi-stream temporal enhanced network (MSTENet) for VSOD. The MSTENet employs a multi-stream structure that leverages both foreground and background supervision to extract collaborative saliency cues in the spatial domain. Meanwhile, the temporally enhanced module focuses on extracting motion information by enhancing distinctive regions in the current frame relative to adjacent frames. The proposed framework seamlessly integrates these two components to achieve more accurate and efficient VSOD performance. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on five benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Wireless Emergency Communication Method based on Electromagnetic Spectrum Environment Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The occurrence of major disasters will have a great impact on local social stability and the safety of people’s lives and property. When a disaster occurs, the emergency communication network should be established quickly, quickly contact with the disaster area, fully understand the current situation of the disaster area, and in the first time to deploy and arrange relief work in the disaster area, to minimize the loss of disaster.With the development of wireless communication technology, various wireless devices emerge one after another, and spectrum resources become scarce resources, so it is necessary to improve the utilization rate of spectrum resources.In this paper, the spectrum detection method of I/Q data is applied to emergency communication, and a wireless communication system is proposed which can sense the electromagnetic spectrum environment of the target region in real time, access the electromagnetic spectrum resources dynamically and resist electromagnetic spectrum interference. The I/Q data spectrum detection method is more accurate than the commonly used energy detection method to distinguish weak signals from noise. The system can independently establish and maintain highly reliable wireless communication links in complex geographical environments.

articleTitle: Multi-scale and Feature Fusion for Expression Recognition Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for face expression recognition that combines multi-scale region awareness with multi-level feature fusion. It aims to overcome the challenge of extracting features from face regions that vary greatly in scale. Firstly, the paper uses an inverse residual structure to perform feature extraction in a high-dimensional space, compensating for the network’s lack of feature extraction capability. Secondly, the paper introduces multi-scale region awareness to address the multi-scale nature of face regions, using multi-scale feature extraction modules to extract features from different receptive fields, as well as multi-scale down-sampling to reduce the feature loss caused by pooling down-sampling. Thirdly, channels and spatial attention are introduced to suppress invalid regions. Finally, adaptive multi-level feature fusion maximises feature information at different depths of the network while avoiding inconsistencies between features. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving accuracy of 73.66%, 98.98%, and 88.07% in FER2013, CK+, and RAF-DB, respectively.

articleTitle: Linear Programming-Based Consensus of T-S Fuzzy Positive Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel consensus for directed T-S fuzzy positive multi-agent systems in terms of observer-based control protocols. First, a directed graph is used to model the communication topology of T-S fuzzy positive multi-agent systems. Second, a positive observer is designed for the considered systems. Then, a control protocol is constructed based on the designed observer. A matrix decomposition approach is introduced to design the corresponding protocol gains. By using co-positive Lyapunov functions and linear programming, the positivity and consensus of T-S fuzzy positive multi-agent systems are achieved. Finally, one simulation example is provided to illustrate the validity of the presented results.

articleTitle: Maritime Single Target Tracking and Positioning Based on Embedded Monocular Vision Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: In recent years, the detection of targets at sea using computer vision methods has been improved. However, it is not enough to get information about the type of target. Therefore, this paper uses a monocular vision which is based ranging model to measure the distance between the target and the observation vessel. Combining the GPS position of the observation vessel and the distance to the target, the latitude and longitude position of the target can be calculated. As a result, the target’s behavioral intent can be determined by recording the target’s movement trajectory. Firstly, this paper uses YOLOV5 algorithm to detect the maritime targets. Then, the target is tracked by moving the camera according to the position of the target in the image. Finally, a monocular visual geometric ranging model for target ranging at sea is developed. The height of the ship and the distance between the target and the observation pass can be obtained by this model. The GPS module is used to obtain the latitude and longitude coordinates of the observation vessel, and the location of the target can be known. In the simulation experiment, the measurement error of the distance between the target and the camera is 5.17 %.

articleTitle: Design a Method for Tracking Moving Object and Predicting its Trajectory in a Noisy Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Target tracking is significant due to the fact that detection and tracking methods are being developed in order to accommodate the system's requirements regarding accuracy and speed. This article will propose a method of target tracking that is intended to address the practical issues of signal loss or a significant amount of noise that affects the process of target detection. The procedure of predicting the course of the object is one of the most promising tasks at the present time, the value of the predictions is apparent in the use of robots, automation and smart tracking radars. The mathematical foundation of the process of predication is related to the previous behavior of the target, the preceding motion of the object conveys information about its general trajectory. This is similar to the Kalman Filter.We created a module that predicts the movement of an object, the module is a hybrid of a Kalman filter and a numerical algorithm that estimates the path of any trajectory in terms of polynomial. The results indicate that the supposed method is a viable solution to the predication problem with the absence of a signal.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of RGB Satellite Urban Images Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: With the increase of satellite data in recent years, we can perceive the detailed structure of the Earth’s surface from it, and obtaining this information opens up new directions for remote sensing image analysis. Generating high-quality building segmentation from RGB satellite images can well predict the geometry of cities, while significant progress has been made in semantic segmentation of satellite images based on deep learning, but most existing methods tend to have poor predictions on segmentation boundaries and poor separation of targets in contact with each other in the same category. In this paper, we propose an improved network based on U-Net by incorporating the SimAM parameter-free attention mechanism. In addition, we solve the problem of irregular contours of building segmentation in satellite images by generating weight mappings with a priori information to be added to the calculation of the loss function. We use a competition dataset named Building Missing Maps with Machine Learning on Aicrowed for training and prediction, and demonstrate that our method has good prediction results on the contours of building semantic segmentation independent of the size of satellite images and the number of datasets.

articleTitle: Dog Face Dataset and Detection Benchmarking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: Dog identification or authentication has extensive practical applications in urban dog management, lost pets, pet insurance, medical treatment, and other fields. Dog face detection is a necessary prerequisite for identifying dogs, which relies on a large number of training samples. Despite the emergence of some dog/dog face datasets, the sample volume and diversity are limited. To this end, this paper constructs a large face detection dataset that covers a large number of dog breeds by collecting dog images and manually annotating them. In addition, we provide a testing benchmark based on the Yolox model. The experimental results of images and videos demonstrate the availability and effectiveness of this dataset. This dataset is at https://github.com/Ruox-Wang/JHUDog.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Average Consensus for Multi-Agent System with Event-Triggered Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The paper considers the privacy-preserving and communication constraints for multi-agent systems. Firstly, a lightweight, decentralized, time-varying transformation method is introduced to prevent information leakage during information exchange between agents. This approach requires less computation and is compatible with systems with limited computing resources. Secondly, the paper proposes an event-triggered mechanism that considers both privacy-preserving and communication constraints to avoid continuous updates of the privacy-preserving controller. By using intermittent communication mode, this approach effectively reduces computing and communication resources compared to traditional time-triggered methods. Overall, these methods offer efficient solutions for privacy and communication challenges in multi-agent systems. The finite-time privacy-preserving control protocol is validated through numerical simulation examples to demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Task-Agnostic Quantize-Aware Training Using Knowledge Feature Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI)
abstract: The more intelligent and complex model has brought huge computing demand and high Memory bandwidth. It is deployed on the embedded neural network accelerator and meets the need to reduce the model bit width in real time to reduce the computing capacity requirements of the model on embedded devices.
